caseNameFull: Guest, President of Methodist Hospital v. Fitzpatrick, District Attorney of Philadelphia and Williamsport Hospital v. Fitzpatrick, District Attorney of Philadelphia

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. E. D. Pa. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 813.] Judgment in No. 75-1691 vacated and case remanded with directions to dismiss cause as moot. Judgment in No. 75-1698 vacated and case remanded for reconsideration in light of intervening circumstances.
